name: Aura Pure Noise-Cancelling Headphones
tagline: Acoustic precision in matte anodized aluminum.
description: Engineered with custom 40mm beryllium drivers, active hybrid noise cancellation, and seamless Bluetooth 5.3 multipoint pairing. Designed for all-day focus.

name: Minimalist Wireless Mechanical Keyboard
tagline: Low-profile tactile switches with double-shot PBT keycaps.
description: Compact 75% layout enclosed in a solid CNC machined zinc-aluminum chassis. Features hot-swappable switches, dual wireless connectivity, and 200-hour battery life.

name: Precision Ergonomic Optical Mouse
tagline: Sculpted for neutral wrist posture and zero tracking latency.
description: 26,000 DPI optical sensor with silent tactile switches and hyper-fast magnetic scrolling. Textured matte finish ensures grip without fingerprint residue.

name: Aura Flow Acoustic Wireless Speaker
tagline: 360-degree room acoustic dispersion in recycled woven wool.
description: Delivers deep bass and balanced high frequencies via dual passive radiators. IPX7 waterproof rating with integrated capacitive touch controls.

name: Architect Desk Task Lamp
tagline: Linear glare-free illumination with ambient color tuning.
description: Ultra-slim counterbalanced arm with touch-controlled brightness and 2700K–6500K color temperature selection. High CRI 95+ light quality protects eye health.

name: Aura Horizon Smart Watch
tagline: Discrete titanium casing with sapphire glass crystal.
description: Continuous biometric telemetry, sleep tracking, and standalone GPS inside an aerospace-grade titanium frame. 7-day battery life with always-on OLED.

name: Wool Felt Desk Pad & Cable Rail
tagline: Merino wool surface with integrated magnetic cord organization.
description: Crafted from natural water-resistant German wool felt with a non-slip cork base. Keeps keyboard, mouse, and workspace cables neatly anchored.

name: True Wireless Studio Earbuds
tagline: Transparency audio pass-through and crystal clear mic array.
description: Ergonomic silicone ear tips with active environmental noise cancellation and wireless charging case. Supports AAC and LDAC high-resolution audio codecs.

name: Anodized Aluminum Monitor Stand
tagline: Elevates display to eye level while storing compact keyboards.
description: Solid single-piece 4mm aluminum plate capable of supporting ultrawide monitors up to 25kg. Clears desk space with dedicated cable pass-through.

name: Ambient Diffused Light Bar
tagline: Screen-mounted asymmetric optical bar reducing screen glare.
description: Clamps directly onto flat or curved monitors without taking up desktop space. Powered via USB-C with wireless dial controller for brightness and hue.

name: Titanium Smart Health Ring
tagline: Finger-worn recovery, temperature, and heart-rate monitoring.
description: Ultra-lightweight 3-gram medical-grade titanium band. Water-resistant to 100m with 6-day battery life and frictionless wireless charging cradle.

name: MagSpeed 3-in-1 Charging Hub
tagline: Simultaneous fast-charging for smartphone, watch, and earbuds.
description: Weighted zinc-alloy pedestal with soft-touch silicone contact pads. 15W Qi2 wireless charging with integrated thermal management.
